[[Plasma Frigate]] }} '''Therian Forme III''' (Japanese: '''VSボルトロスれいじゅうフォルム''' ''VS {{tt|Voltolos Sacred Beast Forme|Thundurus Therian Forme}}''), titled '''VS Thundurus Therian Forme''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 538th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 14th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}. It is subtitled '''Thundurus: Therian Forme''' (Japanese: '''テリアン・フォーム''' ''Therian Forme'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Therian Forme''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Hugh]] meets up with his class and reveals that one of the female students is a member of [[Team Plasma]]. * Hugh decides to leave the school to confront Team Plasma, but {{adv|Whitley}} stops him. * Finding her behavior suspicious, the class begins to piece together Whitley's true identity, but [[Foongy]] puts them to sleep with the exception of Hugh. * Hugh realizes that Whitley is a member of Team Plasma. * {{adv|Blake}} continues battling [[Colress]]. * Blake attempts to arrest [[Zinzolin]], but he is taken away by Colress. * [[Ghetsis]] reveals himself and the [[Plasma Frigate]]. * Blake attempts to stop Ghetsis, but is attacked by the [[Shadow Triad]]. * Colress takes control of {{p|Kyurem}} and puts it in the Plasma Frigate. * The Plasma Frigate is activated and takes to the skies. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Blake}} * {{adv|Whitley}} * {{adv|Cheren}} * {{adv|N}} (photo) * [[Roxie]] * [[Ghetsis]] * [[Colress]] * [[Zinzolin]] * [[Hugh]] * {{adv|Yuki}} * {{adv|Maya}} * {{adv|Yuko}} * [[Shadow Triad]] * {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s * Students ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Dewott}} ({{OP|Blake|Dewott}}) * {{p|Keldeo}} ([[Kelden]];
